sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Technology firmly anchors market leadership with a 0.933 momentum score and sustained top-tier ranking, while Financials lead the deteriorations with a sharp three-spot drop over the last five sessions.

Market breadth remains narrow, with only 2 of 11 sectors posting all-green profiles across all tracked time horizons (week through YTD). Technology continues to demonstrate the strongest sustained performance, holding the #2 YTD spot alongside high momentum, complemented by Energy (#1 YTD) and Basic Materials (#3 YTD). 

Defensive segments are mounting modest short-term rotations, with Healthcare, Consumer Defensive, and Real Estate each ticking up one rank position over the past week. Conversely, Financials experienced a notable loss of footing, tumbling down to rank 8, while Utilities and Consumer Cyclical remain grounded at the bottom of the momentum curve.

## Strength
- **Narrow Breadth:** Only 2 of 11 sectors—Technology (momentum 0.933) and Communication Services (momentum 0.517)—are all-green across the week, month, quarter, half, and YTD frames.
- **Persistent Leader:** Technology is the sole sector demonstrating sustained strength, maintaining a top-3 rank across the 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows.
- **Top Momentum Clusters:** Technology leads overall momentum at 0.933 (rank 2 YTD), followed by Healthcare at 0.700 (rank 5 YTD) and Basic Materials at 0.667 (rank 3 YTD).

## Movers & Momentum
- **Notable Decliners:** Financials fell -3 spots over the last 5 sessions to rank 8, carrying a subdued momentum score of 0.467.
- **Short-Term Improvers:** Minor 5-session rank gains (+1 spot each) emerged in Healthcare (moved to rank 5, momentum 0.700), Consumer Defensive (moved to rank 6, momentum 0.417), and Real Estate (moved to rank 7, momentum 0.267).
- **Deep Laggards:** Utilities registers the weakest momentum across all sectors at 0.100 (rank 10 YTD), with Consumer Cyclical sitting at the bottom rank (rank 11 YTD, momentum 0.317).

## Divergences
- **Communication Services Rank vs. Performance:** Communication Services qualifies as all-green across all time horizons, yet holds a relatively low YTD rank of 9 with a middling 0.517 momentum score.
- **Energy Top Rank vs. Momentum Spread:** Despite Energy commanding the #1 YTD spot, its momentum score of 0.650 trails both Healthcare (0.700) and Technology (0.933).

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** High-momentum leadership remains concentrated in hardware tech and metals, while Biotechnology and Airlines stage sharp multi-day rank advances against deteriorating defensive and services groups.

Market breadth shows narrow perfection, with only 11 of 144 groups holding all-green status across all timeframes. High-conviction leadership remains anchored in Silver (momentum 0.94), Semiconductors (0.93), Electronics & Computer Distribution (0.93), and Computer Hardware (0.92), all sustaining elite positioning. Concurrently, capital is rotating aggressively into previously battered or lower-ranked pockets: Biotechnology surged 28 spots to rank 26 (momentum 0.81), and Airlines advanced 24 spots to rank 88 (momentum 0.64).

Conversely, defensive and recurring-revenue groups are actively fading. Telecom Services plummeted 30 spots to rank 102 with weak momentum (0.23), alongside heavy drop-offs in Integrated Freight & Logistics (-21 spots to rank 62) and Waste Management (-19 spots to rank 104). Consumer and leisure laggards continue to anchor the bottom, led by Gambling (momentum 0.055, rank 143) and Personal Services (0.097, rank 138).

## Strength
- **Narrow All-Green Breadth:** Just 11 of 144 industries are all-green across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD windows, led by Silver (0.94), Semiconductors (0.93), and Electronics & Computer Distribution (0.93).
- **Persistent Outperformers:** Sustained top-36 rank across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons is concentrated in Silver, Semiconductors, Diagnostics & Research (0.88), Consumer Electronics (0.88), Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing, Steel, Internet Content & Information (0.80), and Marine Shipping.
- **Hardware & Metals Dominance:** The top five absolute momentum leaders are Silver (0.938), Semiconductors (0.934), Electronics & Computer Distribution (0.930), Computer Hardware (0.920, YTD rank 1), and Copper (0.888).

## Movers & Momentum
- **Rapid Short-Term Gainers:** Biotechnology jumped 28 spots over five sessions to rank 26 (momentum 0.81), followed by Airlines (+24 spots to rank 88, momentum 0.64) and Internet Content & Information (+15 spots to rank 53, momentum 0.80).
- **Sharp Rank Deterioration:** Telecom Services tumbled 30 spots over 5 sessions to rank 102 (momentum 0.23), Integrated Freight & Logistics dropped 21 spots to rank 62 (momentum 0.37), and Waste Management fell 19 spots to rank 104 (momentum 0.32).
- **Entrenched Laggards:** Consumer-facing services sit at the absolute bottom of momentum rankings, led by Gambling (0.055), Personal Services (0.097), and Resorts & Casinos (0.098).

## Divergences
- **Fading Momentum:** Mature groups exhibiting high momentum but deteriorating 5-day ranks include Insurance - Life (momentum 0.64, rank -10), Oil & Gas Integrated (momentum 0.65, rank -6), Tobacco (momentum 0.62, rank -6), and Banks - Diversified (momentum 0.66, rank -5).
- **Early Emerging Reversals:** Low-momentum groups staging sudden 5-day rank surges include Uranium (+15 spots, momentum 0.34), Utilities - Renewable (+14 spots, momentum 0.36), Aerospace & Defense (+12 spots, momentum 0.50), and Apparel Retail (+10 spots, momentum 0.37).
